revision: User requested modern supreme headquarters styling without nature.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final transparent prestige insignia for the Korean game title “행정부” (administration / supreme headquarters).
Primary request: completely redesign the title emblem in a rigid MODERN SUPREME COMMAND HEADQUARTERS aesthetic. Authoritative, disciplined, severe, exceptionally polished. This is NOT a forest/fantasy/nature emblem.
Subject: a single symmetric machined-metal command insignia. Angular black gunmetal shield with clipped corners, a strong raised platinum five-point command star at the center, three precisely aligned stacked silver rank chevrons underneath. Four smaller silver rank stars in one straight row along the upper edge. Geometric stepped armor plates flank the shield, built from rigid straight metal pieces, not wings or feather shapes.
Style/medium: realistic premium game UI medal render, carefully engineered industrial detailing, finely brushed titanium, dark ceramic inserts, restrained polished silver bevels, subtle cold white edge highlights, tiny desaturated navy inset lines. Elegant hierarchy and excellent legibility at small sizes. No cartoon.
Composition/framing: frontal orthographic view, symmetrical, near-square badge silhouette, one insignia centered and completely visible, 8% transparent margin on all sides. No text plate is needed.
Lighting: sharp controlled cool studio highlights emphasizing metal thickness and precision; no colorful glow cloud.
Backdrop: truly transparent alpha background, all outside the object completely transparent, no scene, floor, environment or display card.
Text: no words, letters, numbers, monograms or watermark. The Korean name and exact description are rendered separately in the app.
Strict exclusions: NO plants, leaves, laurels, wreaths, trees, flowers, forest, nature, animals, feathers, quill, books, scrolls, vines, fantasy filigree, green palette, organic curves, gold medieval ornaments, crowns or real-world military/state logos. Straight rigid modern command geometry only.
